subject: general
question: Centre for Excellence in Artificial Intelligence is an initiative by which organisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Informatics Centre**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Centre for Excellence in Artificial Intelligence is an initiative by the **National Informatics Centre (NIC)**.
 
• NIC, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, established this centre to promote innovations in AI.
 
• The Centre aims to provide a platform for collaborative research, development, and mentoring in the field of AI.
 
• It focuses on creating solutions that can be applied to various sectors such as agriculture, healthcare, education, and governance.
 
• The Centre for Excellence in AI also supports the skill development and training of government officials and other stakeholders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Informatics Centre (NIC)**

 
 
• NIC was established in 1976 and has been instrumental in steering e-Government/e-Governance applications in government departments at the Central, State, and District levels.
 
• It provides a wide range of services including IT infrastructure, application development, and consultancy to the government.
 
• NIC plays a critical role in implementing Digital India initiatives and enhancing the digital infrastructure of the country.
 
• It also offers network services, including the National Knowledge Network (NKN), which connects institutions and research organizations across India.
 
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**
 
 
• AI is a branch of computer science that aims to create machines capable of intelligent behavior.
 
• It encompasses a wide range of technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, robotics, and computer vision.
 
• AI has applications in various fields such as healthcare, finance, autonomous vehicles, and customer service.
 
• The development of AI is accelerating, and it is expected to significantly impact the global economy and society.
 
 
 
• **Digital India Programme**
 
 
• Launched in 2015, the Digital India programme aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• It focuses on three key areas: digital infrastructure, digital services, and digital literacy.
 
• The programme includes initiatives such as BharatNet, e-Kranti, and the Common Services Centres (CSC) scheme.
 
• Digital India is expected to improve access to government services, enhance transparency, and promote digital inclusion.
